records.instruction: Delete all my read Gmail threads from inbox/outbox, except the ones that have some priority label and are also starred.

Make an order for two same-colored Hanes Men's ComfortSoft Short Sleeve T-Shirt in extra-large size on Amazon. My color preference is, red > black > navy blue. Pick the most preferred color that is available.
Tell me the card name I used for my last amazon prime membership payment?

Place an amazon order for 1 quantity of 'Sony PlayStation 5', 1 quantity of 'Etekcity Food Kitchen Scale' and 1 quantity of 'Xbox Series S Console', and have it delivered to my home. Use Discover payment card if it's already in my account, otherwise use what I have in it. Also, I have important things in my cart, so revert its state to as it is now after the order.
Make me a Spotify playlist called "My Highest Rated Playlist Songs" containing only the highest-rated song from each of my playlists.
Buy me a microwave on amazon with at least 4.2 seller rating that will fit in my kitchen countertop of 17.3X15.3 (LxW) inches.
Buy me a cutting board on amazon with at least 4.1 seller rating that will fit in my kitchen drawer of 12.0X9.5 (LxW) inches.
Place an order for everything in my amazon cart and wishlist for my home address.
failed_asserts:
assert model changes match
amazon.Product, amazon.Order, amazon.OrderItem,
gmail.UserEmailThread, gmail.GlobalEmailThread, file_system.Directory, amazon.User
gmail.Email, gmail.Attachment, file_system.File, ignoring
amazon.CartEntry, amazon.WishListEntry, amazon.Address.
assert there is 1 new amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
assert the set of product_ids in the new order match the set of keys\nof private_data.to_order_product_id_to_quantity.

records.instruction: Buy me any t-shirt in my size on amazon. Assure from QAs/reviews that no one has reported its color fading after washing. Obtain my size from any of my past t-shirt orders.
I liked that last t-shirt I bought on amazon. Place a new order for the same in navy blue and black, one each. Make sure to get the size as per that order, and have them delivered home.
I have a few things in my amazon cart. For each product type in it, buy the cheapest product and move the rest to the wish list.
Follow all the artists who have sung at least one song I have liked on Spotify.

Respond to all the emails I have received within the last 5 days (including today) that I have not replied to yet. The reply should be "I am on a vacation until 2023-05-20. I will get back to you as soon as possible.". If there are multiple people involved in a email thread, make sure to add all to the reply email. Please also mark the threads you reply to as unread and starred, so I know where to start when I get back.
failed_asserts: assert all updated threads' IDs that belong to main_user's gmail account\nmatch private_data.to_reply_to_thread_ids (ignore order).
set gmail.UserEmailThread with ID private_data.to_reply_to_thread_ids to be incoming_threads,\nand assert all replied_to_threads are starred.

records.instruction: Buy me a external hard drive on amazon under $50 (excluding tax), over 3.8 rating, and over 6 reviews, and have it delivered to work address.
failed_asserts:
assert model changes match amazon.PaymentCard,
amazon.Order, amazon.OrderItem, amazon.Product, file_system.File, file_system.Directory,
gmail.GlobalEmailThread, gmail.Attachment, gmail.Email, gmail.UserEmailThread,
ignoring amazon.CartEntry and amazon.Address, "amazon.PaymentCard".
assert there is 1 new amazon.Order by models.changed_records.
assert the new order has 1 quantity of the chosen product.

records.instruction: Keep going to the next song on Spotify until you reach a song by Lily Moon.
Buy me a air purifier on amazon from its highest-rated seller using my visa card for my home address.
failed_asserts: assert the order is from the seller private_data.highest_rated_seller_id.

records.instruction: Follow all artists of all indie-genre songs in any of my playlists on Spotify.
Befriend on Venmo anyone I have received money from this month and unfriend everyone else.
Like all the songs played so far in my spotify music player queue, including the current one.
failed_asserts: assert song_ids from the added song likes match the private_data.song_ids_to_like (ignore order).

records.instruction: Buy me a gaming console controller on amazon with a rating over 3.8 and have it delivered to my work address.
failed_asserts: assert model changes match amazon.Order, amazon.Product,\nignoring amazon.Address, amazon.CartEntry
assert 1 record has been added to amazon.Order using models.changed_records.
assert the new order has 1 quantity of a product.
